codebook.journal.la_plus_recente_en_prem: Most recent first. Each operation keeps its reason; it can be undone with another reason as long as no more recent operation touches the same codes.
codebook.journal.le_code_redevient_actif: The code becomes active again with its parent, its subcodes, its aliases and its codings. Anything changed since is not overwritten: it is reported.
codebook.journal.les_decisions_de_la_lis: The decisions of the list are undone, the codings placed since on the new codes go back to the original code, and the new codes are removed.
codebook.journal.n_ramenes_au_code_d_one: {n} moved back to the original code
codebook.journal.n_ramenes_au_code_d_oth: {n} moved back to the original code
codebook.journal.si_une_operation_plus_r: If a more recent operation touches the same codes, it must be undone first.
codebook.les_codes_sont_ajoutes_ou: Codes are added or updated, never deleted. Codes absent from the file are counted and left as they are.
codebook.les_passages_codes_name_prennen: The passages coded "{name}" take the chosen code. The name stays as an alias, and the merge is dated in the history.
codebook.nommez_un_mecanisme_avec_des: Name a mechanism in plain words, and say in one sentence what a passage must express to carry it.

lexicon.keyword_table.creer_un_code_a_pa: Create a code from the ticked words
lexicon.keyword_table.forme_la_plus_freq: Most frequent form of the stem group
lexicon.keyword_table.les_surlignages_de: The highlights of this selection have changed. The table is recomputed.
lexicon.keyword_table.log_vraisemblance_: Log-likelihood (G2) of the word in the highlights against the rest of the respondents' text. Negative when the word is rarer there.
lexicon.keyword_table.nombre_d_entretien: Number of interviews in which a highlight contains the word
lexicon.keyword_table.nombre_de_surligna: Number of highlights that contain the word
lexicon.keyword_table.occurrences_dans_l: Occurrences in the highlights over occurrences in all the respondents' text
lexicon.keyword_table.un_comptage_de_mot: . A word count, never a measure of importance.
lexicon.kwic_search.mot_ou_expression_a_: Word or phrase to search for
lexicon.passage_panel.ce_passage_est_tro: This passage is too short to extract from.
lexicon.passage_panel.extraction_statist: Statistical, deterministic extraction, no generative AI. The label is a suggestion you can ignore.
lexicon.passage_panel.proximite_lexicale: Lexical proximity (TF-IDF on stems): sees neither synonyms nor other languages.
lexicon.term_frequency.occurrences_et_oc: Occurrences and occurrences per 1,000 words by attribute value. An exploratory count, not a prevalence.
lexicon_copy.aucun_tour_d_enquete_ne: No respondent turn contains this search with these filters. Try the stem search, a single word, or remove the attribute filter.
lexicon_copy.choisissez_un_attribut_des_: Choose an interview attribute (for example the sector) and, if you like, words separated by commas. The table gives the number of occurrences and their frequency per 1,000 words in each group of interviews. Without a word, it lists the most frequent words of each group. It is an exploratory count, not a prevalence.
lexicon_copy.le_tableau_des_mots_cles: The keyword table counts, in your highlights without a code, the words (grouped by stem) that come up most compared with the rest of the respondents' text. It judges nothing and uses no generative AI. Highlight passages in Code (key H) to fill it.
lexicon_copy.les_frequences_se_comptent_: Frequencies are counted by the value of an interview attribute. Define an attribute in the study settings, then fill it in for each interview.
lexicon_copy.les_passages_proches_sont_l: Nearby passages are turns from other interviews that share the passage's vocabulary (TF-IDF on stems). None exceeds the threshold for this passage. The lexicon sees neither synonyms nor other languages.
lexicon_copy.selectionnez_un_surlignage_: Select a highlight: the panel shows its key phrases (YAKE), its stems and a provisional label that you can use or ignore.
lexicon_copy.tapez_un_mot_ou_une: Type a word or a phrase to see each of its occurrences in the middle of its sentence, across all interviews. Case and accents are ignored. Tick the stem search to also find neighbouring forms (recall, recalled). Only the respondents' turns are searched.
lexique.choisissez_un_surlignage_le_lexi: Choose a highlight: the lexicon looks, in the other interviews, for the turns that share its vocabulary, with a proximity score. It helps check the coverage of a code and find what you missed.
lexique.les_mots_regroupes_par_racine: The words (grouped by stem) that come up most in the highlights without a code, compared with the rest of the respondents' text. Tick words to create a code: the highlights that contain them are attached to it.
lexique.les_passages_proches_se_calculen: Nearby passages are computed from a highlight. In Code, select a passage with the mouse then press H.
lexique.surlignages_et_lexique_statistiq: Highlights and lexicon · statistical and deterministic, no generative AI

revoir.la_revue_n_a_pas: The review could not be loaded

revoir.revue_ia.collez_ici_la_reponse_du: Paste the model's response here, as is. A malformed response is refused as a whole, with the list of problems.
revoir.revue_ia.facultatif_il_fait_l_all: Optional: it makes the round trip for you. Copy and paste remains the reference.
revoir.revue_ia.generer_le_prompt_fige_v: Generating the prompt freezes your coding of this interview as it stands at that moment. It is the reference for the comparison, even if you change your mind afterwards. Your codes never appear in the prompt.
revoir.revue_ia.items_pas_encore_codes_l: {items} not coded yet. The prompt is generated when all relevant turns are coded.
{items} not coded yet. The prompt is generated when all relevant turns are coded.

revoir.revue_ia.la_revue_ia_est_facultat: The AI review is optional. The model goes after you and never receives your coding: it reads the turns and the codebook, then its codes are compared with yours.

revoir.revue_ia.nommez_le_modele_utilise: Name the model used before importing a response.

reviewer.title: Final reviewer export
reviewer.description: Choose content and create a protected review package, ready to host.
reviewer.local_only: Nothing has been published. To host the package, use upload.zip and preserve its structure.
reviewer.password_separate: Send the password separately. It is not saved in the exported package.
reviewer.url_prepared: URL and QR prepared for: {url}. Hosting remains to be set up.
reviewer.rules: {n} project rules, plus configured researcher names. Review the text: zero replacements does not mean anonymous.
reviewer.selection_help: Expand a section down to individual fields. A folder checkbox selects all its fields. Original files, identities and AI passes start unchecked.
reviewer.search_count: {n} results, showing the first 100. Checkboxes target each displayed field.
reviewer.included: This field will be included. Preview limited to 16,000 characters; the complete field will be exported.
reviewer.preview_help: Click a field name to read its content before selecting it.
reviewer.password_help: Choose a long, unique passphrase of at least 16 characters. Keep it safely: the tool cannot recover it.
reviewer.url_help: Leave blank until hosting is defined. No public link or QR will be created. An address must not contain a password or access parameter.
reviewer.url_invalid: Use an HTTPS address without credentials, query parameters or a fragment.
reviewer.summary: {fields} fields and {files} original files ({mb} MiB) will be included.
reviewer.masked_copy: Names from the configured list will be replaced in the copy. This does not guarantee anonymity.
reviewer.original_copy: Text will be exported without replacing names.
reviewer.with_url: A URL and its QR will be added. The package will not be uploaded automatically.
reviewer.without_url: Local export only, without a public URL or QR.
reviewer.review_help: The password protects the encrypted content. Do not place it in the hosted folder. Downloaded copies cannot be revoked.
reviewer.attachments_help: Original files may reveal names or voices. They remain intact and are not pseudonymised. They are encrypted in chunks; the reader can download files up to 1 GiB.
reviewer.acknowledge: I have reviewed the selection and will keep the password separate from the exported package.
reviewer.coverage: {interviews} interviews, including {transcripts} with a segmented transcript. For the others, select source files if needed.
anonymizer.title: Anonymise
anonymizer.local: Manual dictionary, without a model. Originals and coding are preserved. To detect names with your local model at import, use transcript preparation below.
anonymizer.limits: Known names are replaced. Emails, international phone numbers and URLs are masked separately. Detection cannot guarantee that unknown names, addresses or identifying details are absent: review each copy.
anonymizer.private_help: This table stays in the local database. It is excluded from anonymised exports and AI review prompts. Personal names are protected even when an older record opted out.
anonymizer.same_person: Same person: reuse the label. Different person: distinct label.
anonymizer.candidates_help: Capitalisation hints, without AI: many are ordinary words. Click to prepare a replacement and check its context. Add forms missed by these hints.
anonymizer.prompt: Improved reference prompt · local execution only
anonymizer.attest: I reviewed the entire copy, including speakers, ambiguous names, contact details and indirect identifiers. The replacements are faithful.
anonymizer.prompt_help: Display and review every prompt part: study description, codebook, attributes, questions and answers. Interview approval is also required.
anonymizer.prompt_attest: I checked the complete prompt and left no identity or contact detail to share with an AI.
anonymizer.prompt_ready: Prompt reviewed: copying and sending enabled for this version.
anonymizer.prompt_blocked: Copying and AI sending blocked until anonymisation is reviewed.
anonymizer.stale: The prompt changed: refresh and review the current version.
anonymizer.sidebar_help: Mandatory masking. Review the interview copy and complete prompt before copying or sending it to an AI.
preparation.local_help: Original text is sent only to this local address or private IP. No proxy, redirects or fallback service. Use a trusted local server, such as LM Studio.
preparation.anonymise: Anonymise personal names, including speaker labels
preparation.cleanup: Light cleanup: spelling, punctuation and meaningless vocal fillers
preparation.language_help: Empty: keep the original language. Otherwise: English, French…
preparation.save: Save these settings for this project
preparation.saved: Local settings saved for this database.
preparation.on_import: Prepare transcripts with a local model after import
preparation.title: Prepare transcripts
preparation.select_help: Choose interviews to prepare. New interviews are preselected at import. Already coded or reviewed interviews receive a separate reading copy only.
preparation.processing: The local model processes the interview according to the available context. This can take several minutes. Sources and coding stay intact until approval.
preparation.context_help: Use the same value as the server. Anonymisation sends the whole interview when it fits the estimated context, with a safety margin. Cleanup and translation also respect the output limit.
preparation.from_library_help: Choose operations and interviews. Already coded interviews keep their reference transcript and highlights; a separate reading copy is prepared.
preparation.coded_copy: This interview has already been coded or reviewed. The approved version will be a reading/export copy. The reference text, codes and anchors will remain intact.
persons.excel_map_help: Map columns to fields. Separate first and last names will be joined. Interviews may contain INT-01 or INT-01;INT-02:interviewer. Check the preview before applying.
persons.excel_too_large: The Excel file exceeds 5 MiB. Prepare a copy containing only participants.
persons.excel_old_format: Save this .xls file as .xlsx or CSV before importing.
reviewer.identified_help: This version may contain selected names, participant/interview links and original sources. Choose fields and sources in the tree. All contents will be encrypted; a password is required and must be shared separately.

participant.codes: Include coded passages and applied codes
participant.themes: Include themes linked to this interview
